scenes.title: Why does a straw look bent in water?

scenes.narration: When a ray of light passes from air into water, it changes direction at the boundary.

scenes.title: Light bends as it enters the water

scenes.narration: Because water is denser, the light slows and bends closer to the normal, the line perpendicular to the surface.

scenes.title: It bends toward the normal

scenes.narration: The more optically dense a medium, the slower light travels, and the more it bends.

scenes.title: Denser medium, slower light

scenes.narration: This bending of light as it crosses between media is called refraction.
